title: Practice: set up a repository for Claude Code (TypeScript)

cases.id: m1 the memory file is short concrete and pulls in the architecture notes
cases.says: The memory file is short, names the commands, and its import resolves to the architecture notes

cases.id: e1 the permission rules allow the daily commands ask before commits and deny secrets and pushes
cases.says: Sixteen sample calls get the right answer from the merged rules: allow, ask or deny

cases.id: e2 the shared file sets a mode it may set and uses only rules that are consulted
cases.says: The shared file sets a mode it is allowed to set and uses only rules that Claude Code consults

cases.id: e3 personal settings stay local and the local file wins
cases.says: The personal file wins for its owner, is ignored by git and stays small

cases.id: e4 the custom command is a skill that only a person can start
cases.says: The custom command is a skill with an argument hint that Claude cannot start by itself

cases.id: e5 the headless script is bounded and does not skip permissions
cases.says: The headless script is capped, does not skip permissions and pre-approves no whole tool that changes things

cases.id: e6 no file holds a personal path an address or a key
cases.says: No file holds a personal path, an address or a key
